examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}は{残業|ざんぎょう}があります。
{毎日|まいにち}{残業|ざんぎょう}で{疲|つか}れました。
examples.english: I'm tired from overtime every day.

examples.japanese: {残業|ざんぎょう}{代|だい}が{出|で}ますか。
examples.english: Do you get paid for overtime?

examples.japanese: {今月|こんげつ}は{残業|ざんぎょう}が{多|おお}くて{大変|たいへん}です。
examples.english: I have a lot of overtime this month and it's tough.

examples.japanese: {会社|かいしゃ}は{残業|ざんぎょう}を{減|へ}らそうとしていますが、{仕事|しごと}が{終|お}わりません。
examples.english: The company is trying to reduce overtime, but the work doesn't get finished.

notes: 残業 combines 残 (remain) and 業 (work). 残業する means to work overtime. 残業代 (ざんぎょうだい) is overtime pay. Japan has been working to reduce excessive overtime (過労死, karōshi - death from overwork - is a recognized problem).
